scope_note: Concept-side only. Proves the 5.6 Pro surface behaves as the correction specifies. It is NOT native proof: no Rust handler, storage engine, scheduler, provider adapter or recovery path is exercised. Adapter conformance, real dispatch, and wiring proof require a live native runtime and are explicitly out of scope for this suite.
